{'text': 'iOS 27.2將於下週推出，該更新包含的代碼顯示「訊息」App即將有新改動：可以將已靜音的對話排除在未讀徽章數量之外。', 'paragraph_context': 'iOS 27.2 launches next week, and the update includes code that points to a forthcoming Messages app change: the ability to exclude muted conversations from the unread badge count.'}

{'text': 'Apple正研發新功能\u3000可將已靜音的「訊息」對話排除在未讀徽章數量之外', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple working on feature to exclude muted Messages conversations from unread badge count'}

{'text': '你是否有加入非常活躍的群組聊天？又或者你的生活中有些人，你在「訊息」App中寧可將他們設為靜音？', 'paragraph_context': 'Do you belong to a very active group chat? Or are there people in your life that you prefer to keep on mute in the Messages app?'}

{'text': '如果以上情況符合你一種或兩種，那麼將這些對話靜音後，「訊息」App的未讀徽章數量卻沒有減少，可能會令你感到困擾。', 'paragraph_context': 'If either or both is true, it might bug you that muting those conversations doesn’t impact the Messages app’s unread badge count.'}

{'text': '不過根據iOS 27.2代碼顯示，這情況很快可能會有所改變。', 'paragraph_context': 'Except soon, according to iOS 27.2 code, that might finally change.'}

{'text': 'Aaron Perris本週於X上發文分享了這項發現：', 'paragraph_context': 'Aaron Perris shared the discovery this week in a post on X:'}

{'text': 'LeonardoM的熱門留言', 'paragraph_context': 'Top comment by LeonardoM'}

{'text': '我仍在等待Apple加入可以隱藏特定對話、並只能透過密碼及Face ID才能查看的一天。', 'paragraph_context': 'Still waiting for the day Apple adds the possibility to hide specific chats and make them accessible exclusively with password AND face ID.'}

{'text': '就我個人而言，我對這個潛在改動感到非常興奮。', 'paragraph_context': 'Personally, I’m very excited by this potential change.'}

{'text': '我在「訊息」中將幾個繁忙的群組聊天設為靜音，以免不斷收到通知轟炸。而作為一個在大多數App上都關閉通知徽章的人，紅色徽章總是非常顯眼。所以每當「訊息」中已靜音的群組聊天出現未讀徽章，總是讓我感到煩厭。', 'paragraph_context': 'I keep a couple of busy group chats muted inside Messages so I’m not pinged with notifications constantly. And as someone who keeps notification badges disabled for most apps, a red badge is always very noticeable. So it always bothers me when Messages has an unread badge for group chats I’ve muted.'}

{'text': '雖然這項功能似乎不會在iOS 27.2中正式推出，但希望Apple能盡快提供這功能。', 'paragraph_context': 'While it sounds like this feature won’t ship in iOS 27.2, hopefully Apple is able to offer it soon.'}

{'text': '如果Apple提供這項「訊息」選項，你會使用嗎？歡迎在留言區告訴我們。', 'paragraph_context': 'Would you use this Messages option if Apple provided it? Let us know in the comments.'}
